place_teabox_front_of_skillet.instruction: Put the tea box in front of the skillet.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move above the tea box while beginning downward orientation, clear of the tabletop.
Complete vertical gripper alignment above the tea box and move toward its front-table location.
Adjust the open downward gripper over the tea box using the camera alignment.
Center the fingers on the tea box and descend to grasp its sides.
Close the right gripper on the tea box at the aligned grasp pose.
Lift the grasped tea box clear of the table and verify it moves with the gripper.
Carry the lifted tea box to the open tabletop in front of the skillet, beyond its handle.
Lower the held tea box toward the tabletop in front of the skillet, using a nearer reachable placement after the tracking stop.
Move the held box slightly forward and lower with the measured orientation to regain reachability in front of the skillet.
Lower the tea box toward its resting height on the tabletop in front of the skillet.
Release the tea box at the low placement pose in front of the skillet.
Allow the fingers to finish opening at the fixed release pose before withdrawing.
The tea box has been released in front of the skillet; the simulator reports success.

attr_bind_soap_box.instruction: Use the right arm to lift the yellow tea box.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move above the middle-sized central block, partially rotating the open gripper downward within the rotation limit.
Complete the downward grasp orientation in clear space above the medium central block.
Lower the open downward-facing gripper toward the medium block, correcting its lateral alignment.
Bring the open fingers down around the medium block, with a small forward alignment correction.
Lower the open fingers slightly farther alongside the medium block before closing, retaining the measured orientation.
Align the open fingers with the medium block's center by moving toward the robot at the current grasp height.
Close the right gripper around the medium block at the measured fixed pose.
Lift the closed gripper vertically 10 cm, preserving orientation, and check that the medium block rises with it.
The medium block is grasped in the right gripper and lifted clear of the table.

ref_block_on_plate.instruction: Pick up the block on the plate.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move above the plate in clear space, tilting the open gripper toward a downward grasp.
Align vertically over the plate and approach with the open gripper, keeping clearance above the block.
Lower the open fingers toward the plate block, correcting the small lateral offset while retaining a vertical grasp.
Adjust toward the center of the plate block and lower slightly, using the measured orientation after the tracking stop.
Center the open fingertips around the plate block by moving slightly toward the robot and down to grasp height.
Close the right fingers around the block centered on the plate, holding the measured grasp pose.
Lift vertically clear of the plate with the fingers commanded closed, checking whether the block is securely held.
Picked up the block from the plate; it is held in the right gripper visibly clear of the plate.

ref_block_behind_can.instruction: Pick up the block behind the can.

ref_cup_on_tray.instruction: Pick up the block on the tray.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move above the tray with open fingers and tilt toward a downward grasp while remaining clear of objects.
Finish downward orientation above the tray and align the open gripper for the block.
Lower the open gripper toward the tray block, completing vertical alignment and checking clearance.
Align the open fingers over the tray block, moving toward its visible center while descending cautiously.
Lower the open fingers around the block on the tray, keeping them clear of the tray floor.
Adjust toward the block center and lower using the measured wrist orientation to improve tracking.
Close the fingers around the tray block at the measured pose; inspect actual aperture and block motion before lifting.
Lift the grasped block vertically clear of the tray, preserving the wrist orientation and closed-gripper command.
The block has been grasped and lifted clear of the tray.

lift_pot_to_pad.instruction: Please lift the pot with both arms and put it on the pad.

decisions.note: Bring the left open gripper above the left pot handle for visual alignment.
transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Rotate partway toward a downward grasp while moving in clear space above the pot.
Complete downward orientation with the open gripper above the left handle, then inspect alignment.
Lower toward the left handle while completing the remaining downward tilt in reachable space.
Align the left open fingers over the left handle bar and descend toward grasp height.
Center the left gripper opening on the visible outer handle bar before closing.
Raise slightly and align the open left gripper centrally above the pot's left handle.
Align over the left handle at a lower reachable wrist height, avoiding the upward joint limit.
Back the wrist toward the robot and reduce downward pitch to clear the joint limit while keeping the fingers above the handle.
Bring the right open gripper above the opposite pot handle to prepare a two-arm grasp.
Lower the right gripper toward the right handle with a matching sixty-degree downward approach.
Align the right fingers farther outward over the right handle bar and lower to surround it.
Fine-align the right opening over the handle bar using the wrist view and descend to grasp depth.
Close the right gripper at the measured handle-aligned pose and check whether the handle is captured.
Position the left fingers around the left handle while the right gripper settles on the opposite handle.
Close the left gripper on the opposite handle at the measured pose; inspect both apertures before lifting.
Begin a small shared lift with the left handle, keeping the opposite grasp engaged and checking pot motion.
Lift the right handle to follow the left, raising the pot with both grasps engaged.
Raise the left handle to establish clearance under the pot while maintaining both grasps.
Level the raised pot and start carrying its right handle toward the pad, keeping the displacement small for the shared grasp.
Carry the left handle toward the pad in a short shared-transport step, maintaining pot clearance and the grasp.
Advance the right handle toward the pad while the left supports the other handle, maintaining the lifted height.
Bring the left handle forward to follow the right toward the pad, keeping the pot elevated.
Adjust the left wrist downward and slightly lower while advancing toward the pad to avoid the wrist tracking limit, with the right handle supported.
Move the right handle forward and slightly down to follow the left toward the pad while both hands retain the pot.
Bring the left handle forward to level the pot above the visible pad before lowering.
Begin lowering the right side of the pot toward the pad, preserving the two-handle grasp.
Lower the left handle to bring the pot level and close above the pad, retaining both grasps.
Gently lower the right handle to seat the pot on the pad, with the left hand still supporting the other handle.
Settle the left side gently so the pot rests evenly on the pad before releasing both handles.
Release the left handle now that the pot is seated on the pad, with the right hand retaining support.
Open the right gripper to release the other handle and leave the pot resting on the pad.
Withdraw the open left gripper upward and back from the released pot to verify stable placement on the pad.
Lifted the pot using both handles, placed it on the pad, and released both grippers. Placement success is confirmed by simulator feedback.

ref_block_on_plate_mix.instruction: Pick up the block on the plate.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move through clear space above the plate with an intermediate downward wrist orientation.
Complete the downward orientation above the plate while keeping the fingers clear of the block.
Approach above the plate block with open fingers, leaving clearance to refine alignment before grasping.
Lower the open fingers alongside the plate block, correcting the small lateral offset for a centered grasp.
Bring the open fingers to the sides of the block just above the plate for a secure grasp.
Close the gripper at its measured pose around the block on the plate.
Lift vertically with the grasp maintained, clearing the block from the plate.
The block has been grasped and lifted clear of the plate, and is held in the right gripper.

attr_teabox_basket_then_ring.instruction: Put the tea box into the basket, then press the bell.

decisions.note: transit rotation exceeds 90.0 degrees
Move above tea box, partially rotate downward while clear of objects.
Complete top-down alignment above the tea box before descending.
Approach the tea box from above and center the open fingers around its narrow sides.
Lower open fingers to grasp the tea box sides without contacting the table.
Close around the tea box at the aligned grasp pose.
Lift the tea box vertically and verify that it remains between the fingers.
Carry the grasped tea box above the center of the yellow basket, clearing its rim.
Lower the held tea box toward the basket opening, correcting the small tracking offset at a more reachable height.
Lower the tea box into the basket opening while preserving the measured wrist orientation.
Release the tea box over the basket opening rather than forcing further downward motion.
Withdraw the open gripper upward, allowing the released tea box to settle into the basket.
Tea box has settled inside the basket. Bring the left gripper above the bell, starting a downward orientation.
Orient the left gripper vertically over the silver bell while safely above it.
Close the empty gripper above the bell to form a narrow pressing tip.
Bring the closed fingertips down above the bell button, leaving clearance for a controlled press.
Center the closed fingertips over the bell's button and approach just above it.
The tea box is inside the basket, and the bell has been pressed. Simulator feedback confirms success.
